meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual question framing from the linked English and Tamil Term II textbooks. Includes prose, activities, diagrams, numerical problems, points to remember, ICT, evaluation and HOTS. No preset question cap; no unsupported gap-filling.
source_notes: Both linked Drive files were identified as Class 6 Science Term II 2024 editions: Tamil and English respectively.
Question wording preserves textbook framing and numerical values; explanations use only chapter-supported facts unless explicitly marked as an inference.
Numerical Problem 1 is converted using the inference invited by the textbook: 1 L heated through the same temperature rise in the same time as ½ L implies about twice the heat transfer.
HOTS answers about an open winter window, lower body temperature and a heated disk hole are source-supported reasoning from the chapter's heat-flow and expansion rules, not verbatim answer lines.
meta.question_style: Natural competitive-exam wording; no routine 'according to the textbook' phrasing.
meta.quality_policy: Competitive-exam useful questions only. Classroom stories, activity props, learning-objective recall, ICT steps, picture trivia and low-value procedural questions removed.
meta.quality_note: Correct-answer positions rebalanced to five per option in every quiz, with no repeated-answer run longer than two. English and Tamil options were moved as paired choices, preserving all correct answers.
